name: FAQ Section
summary: Container-responsive contextual wrapper that composes one required canonical Accordion without duplicating disclosure state or behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: FAQ context root rendered as a title-labelled native section when titled and as a generic grouping when untitled.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional introduction present only when a title or subtitle is supplied.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading whose target-unique id names the native section.

anatomy.name: subtitle
anatomy.description: Optional supporting context that never substitutes for a visible section title.

anatomy.name: accordionList
anatomy.description: Required contextual hook on the complete canonical Accordion composition.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeatable ordered FAQ item that also preserves complete canonical Accordion item anatomy.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One centered optional introduction followed by one ordered canonical Accordion.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic size whose maximum measures and container-relative padding curve remain private composition.

states.name: default
states.description: Complete FAQ context with one or more ordered items; item states remain canonical Accordion states.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Targets omit the complete wrapper when the ordered item composition is absent, empty, or contains no valid items.

behavior.name: conditionalSectionSemantics
behavior.description: A non-empty visible title creates and names a native thematic section; an untitled wrapper is a generic div and subtitle text alone does not create a section landmark.

behavior.name: accordionComposition
behavior.description: FAQ Section consumes canonical Accordion anatomy, trigger/panel relationships, hidden state, disabled state, focus, keyboard activation, indicator and content flow without recreating them.

behavior.name: targetOwnedGroupPolicy
behavior.description: Single, multiple, exact-exclusive, collapsible, required-open, initial and controlled/uncontrolled policies belong to the Accordion consumer or target rather than FAQ Section.

behavior.name: optionalPanelRegions
behavior.description: Panels do not receive region semantics by default; targets opt in only for structurally significant panels without creating landmark proliferation.

behavior.name: essentialInformation
behavior.description: Information every user must read to complete a critical task remains visible outside collapsed FAQ answers and nested accordions are unsupported.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Short, long, empty, localized, RTL and unbroken content remains contained through logical, component-width-aware composition without viewport- or Studio-owned layout rules.

behavior.name: passiveWrapperRuntime
behavior.description: FAQ Section itself owns no state, event, listener, observer, request, timer, layout read, asset, custom element, animation or neutral runtime.

properties.name: title
properties.unsetBehavior: Render no title; use a generic root instead of an unnamed native section.
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; targets choose the contextual heading rank and unique id.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the subtitle without leaving an empty node or rhythm.
properties.description: Optional supporting FAQ context that never replaces the visible title as a section name.

properties.name: items
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete FAQ Section when no valid canonical Accordion items are supplied.
properties.description: Required non-empty ordered canonical Accordion composition rendered after the optional introduction.

accessibility: Omit the component without valid items; use a title-labelled native section only when a non-empty visible contextual title exists and otherwise use a generic root.
Compose canonical Accordion headings, native triggers, expanded/disabled state, stable relationships, hidden panels, keyboard activation, focus and content semantics without duplication.
Do not give every answer a region landmark by default; opt in only when a panel is structurally significant and landmark count remains useful.
Keep information required for a critical task visible outside collapsed answers and do not nest accordions.
Preserve ordered question/answer source order, localized and RTL content, visible focus, text/border/focus contrast, forced-color semantics and reduced-motion behavior.

web.notes: Conditional section semantics and container-responsive S9 CSS compose canonical Accordion; the consumer owns group state and panel-region policy.

shopify.notes: Localized merchant section maps valid ordered blocks to native details/summary with canonical Accordion classes, theme-editor attributes and no target script.
